script.problem: A quote isn't the BSB's exact words.

terra.problem: Abner setting Ish-bosheth up as king is a fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
“This was not one of them” suggests Papa Dorin was present for the event.
Abner setting Saul’s son up as king is a fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
Abner speaks of establishing David’s throne, not moving a throne.
Calling Abner a commander draws on a fact outside this passage without a reference.
The oven-buzzer comparison does not make clear why Papa was silent or how that relates to Ish-bosheth’s fear.
The text says Ish-bosheth did not answer Abner; it does not say the room went quiet.
Merab being Saul’s daughter is a fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
“No stalling” adds timing the text does not give. The guess about Ish-bosheth’s mood also suggests a reason for his action that the text does not give.
Saying Paltiel was left behind conflicts with the next verse, where he follows Michal.
The passage does not say where David was during Paltiel’s journey, so it does not establish that he was not on the road.
The promise about David’s line comes from outside the passage and needs a reference.
The reference to Israel crossing the Jordan draws on a fact outside the passage without a reference.
The passage does not name Levites, but saying they do not show up rules out their presence among groups the text mentions.
The claim that Ephraim is a big tribe draws on a fact outside the passage without a reference.
The text says Abner went in peace; it does not say he crossed a war front line or had no trouble at all.
